main.description: A community's ban of an account, written to the community's own repo. The record applies only in the repo of an indexed community. The record key is deterministic: RFC 4648 base32 (alphabet a-z2-7), lowercase, unpadded, of SHA-256 over the subject DID's UTF-8 bytes. It is always 52 characters and rkey-safe; for example, did:plc:troublemaker456 has the key a5uzm6rn7ba5hnqtdjrd22rg53skdtu6ksiksa5eini4ychhrcpa. A community therefore holds at most one ban record per subject. Writing the record again at that key overwrites the ban, and deleting it lifts the ban. A record at any other key is rejected and not indexed. With expiresAt the ban is temporary and ends at that time; without expiresAt it is permanent. A banned account's posts, comments and votes in the community are refused while the ban is in force.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the ban, shown to the banned account

expiresAt.description: When the ban ends. Omitted for a permanent ban.

createdAt.description: When the ban was issued or last changed
